title: Gold Bar XL Blueberry Sour Raspberry Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: The Gold Bar XL Refill Kit in Blueberry Sour Raspberry serves up a lively duo of Blueberry and Raspberry with all the tart, tangy depth you would expect from a classic berry pairing like this. The sweet, jammy Blueberry base is lifted by the sharper Raspberry flavour, offering a vibrant fruit blend with a clean finish and smooth MTL draw. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and an attached 10ml refill reservoir, both preloaded with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid for extended vaping performance. Designed for use with the Gold Bar XL Prefilled Pod Kit, these refills offer a simple and satisfying way to enjoy top-quality flavour. The built-in mesh coil helps produce clean vapour and consistent flavour with every puff. Once both pod and refill are empty, simply replace with a new flavour from the wide Gold Bar XL range.
